The drop rate for this book is higher in story mode with a base rate of 1/10 and uses the following formula:
• (10+X)/100 where X is the amount of group and solo kills
This guarantees the player will receive the book as a drop if running the dungeon in story mode with 90 kills or more recorded outside of story mode.
